core_obligations: Choose surjective \'etale charts V \to Y and U \to X \times_Y V, and verify U \to V is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation because f is (proof lines 1128-1134).

Reduce to schemes using that local Noetherianity of algebraic spaces is defined via such charts (cited Properties of Spaces section), and conclude by the fppf descent lemma for Noetherian schemes (proof lines 1135-1139).
proof_roadmap: Pick the \'etale charts and transport the hypotheses on f to the scheme morphism U \to V.
Invoke the scheme-case fppf descent of local Noetherianity.
difficulty_reason: The proof reduces to schemes by charts: choose surjective \'etale V \to Y and U \to X \times_Y V; since f is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, the scheme morphism U \to V is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation; local Noetherianity of the spaces is defined through that of the charts, so the scheme case of fppf descent of Noetherianity (cited Descent lemma) concludes. The chart reduction and the compatibility with the definition of local Noetherianity for spaces are the substance.
